# Sai ATLAS

> Sai ATLAS is the private AI assistant for everyday work on SAI OS: it writes Word reports, cleans up spreadsheets, turns reports into slides and helps when the computer misbehaves, running locally through Ollama on Linux x64.

Sai ATLAS runs on the user's own computer, needs no account, answers in English or Vietnamese and asks before it changes anything. Files and conversations stay on the computer; it goes online only to download models and updates. It is built on the open-source omp agent and released under the MIT license.

## Docs

- [Sai ATLAS home page](https://tung491.github.io/sai-atlas/index.md): what Sai ATLAS does, its privacy model and how to install it.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tung491/sai-atlas/releases): Linux x64 .deb and AppImage downloads.
- [README](https://github.com/tung491/sai-atlas#readme): building from source and project details.
